title: pvOMETIFFReader
body:
## pvOMETIFFReader

Reads an OME-TIFF microscopy file (.ome.tif, .ome.tiff), using its OME-XML metadata to split the TIFF pages into z-planes, channels and time steps; the output is uniform image data with time steps. Only single-file, multi-page OME-TIFF is supported. Use pvOMETIFFChannelCalculator downstream to combine channels, or pvTIFFSeriesReader for plain TIFF.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Multi-file OME-TIFF datasets are not read correctly; use the single-file form.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `OMETIFFReader`. Identity: `sources/OMETIFFReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CustomDataSpacing` | Set the spacing to use for the image output by this reader. This is used only when **UseCustomDataSpacing** is set to 1. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `FileName` | This property specifies the file name for the OME-TIFF reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `IgnoreColorMap` | When checked, data values in the TIFF file will not be mapped to colors using the color map specified in the TIFF, if any. This is useful for files where the color map may be incorrectly specified. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `UseCustomDataSpacing` | To manually specify a custom spacing using **CustomDataSpacing**, set this property to 1 (checked). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,

```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvOMETIFFReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
